title: Jennifer Marques of Oaktree - Asset Backed Finance and the Power of the Team
summary: Marquez advised taking risks, providing solutions, and remaining calm in crises. She started her career as a corporate lawyer, first in private practice and then within Oaktree. She discussed her career journey from law to finance, emphasizing the importance of resilience.
